objective: Connect every Epoch AI site to the most specific public electricity queue, service, utility, regulatory, planning or connection record available.
semantics: evidence_found means a site-level source was identified. It does not mean every site has a formal public queue ID. queue IDs are only assigned to defensible queue matches.

site_level_evidence.source_kind: dated local reporting on utility request
site_level_evidence.basis: The August 20, 2026 report states that SpaceXAI asked TVA to directly supply more electricity to its Colossus II campus spanning Memphis and Southaven. This establishes a site-specific TVA power relationship/request, not a queue ID.

records.next_action: Search TVA/serving-utility filings, local regulatory records and any interconnection or service agreement record that identifies the campus by case or project number.

site_level_evidence.basis: The facility record identifies Georgia Power as the utility and describes the Ashley Park 500/230-kV substation and customer substations serving the Fayetteville campus. This is utility/site evidence, not a site-specific queue ID.

records.next_action: Search Georgia PSC and Georgia Power large-load filings for the Fairwater/QTS Fayetteville campus, including docket records and service/interconnection documentation.

site_level_evidence.record_name: Project Rainier / New Carlisle power supply
site_level_evidence.basis: The facility record identifies grid power from Indiana Michigan Power together with natural-gas generation for the Amazon Project Rainier campus in New Carlisle. This is site-level utility evidence, not a formal queue ID.

records.next_action: Search Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission and Indiana Michigan Power records for the New Carlisle Project Rainier service/interconnection case.

site_level_evidence.record_name: Google Pryor power supply / customer relationship

records.next_action: Search GRDA, MidAmerica Industrial Park and Oklahoma Corporation Commission records for a site-specific Google Pryor service/interconnection document or project number.
